integrity: All mathematical claims are same-model reviewed, not independently audited. Exact coefficients and integral-kernel moments were derived separately; the finite numerical checks are corroborative rather than a proof of infinite-dimensional assertions.
scientific_limitations: The entire determinant characterizes the complete nonzero singular spectrum implicitly. No elementary root formulas, exact root-order multiplicities, or sharp high-index constant are claimed. Computed decimal roots are approximations only. Historical weighted spectral transformations may contain an equivalent characterization.
title: An entire characteristic determinant for the singular spectrum of the Hardy–Volterra commutator
